headline: Israeli Strikes Reportedly Hit Iran’s Kharg Island Oil Hub
summary: Israeli strikes reportedly hit Kharg Island, Iran's main crude oil export hub. The reports raise fears of disruption to Gulf shipping.
why: Kharg Island handles most of Iran's crude exports, so attacks there affect global oil supply and tanker routes through the Gulf.

source.name: Pragativadi I Latest Odisha News in English I Breaking News
